title: blechnum underwoodianum var. ekmanii
intro: Blechnum underwoodianum var. ekmanii, commonly known as the Ekman's chain fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Blechnaceae. It is a type of fern that is native to the tropical regions of South America and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Blechnum underwoodianum var. ekmanii include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, antitumor, and anti-inflammatory effects.
